name: visual-anatomy-studio
description: Builds a single-file, multi-perspective interactive HTML explainer on any topic and deploys it to a public URL: researches current data, generates scientific-style illustrations and 10s H3 video clips, and wires clickable hotspots, drag comparators, scrubber timelines and a scale map of the viewpoints. Encodes six interaction bug classes and a position-and-pixel verification harness.
